name: Categories
description: Review the sidebar's categories and change them: add one, change its icon, move it, or remove one no script uses. 'Give generic-icon categories the image's icon' fixes categories that arrived with the plain tag icon. Changes go to conf/categories.json (the previous version is kept as categories.json.bak); reload the page to see them. A script joins a category with "category": "Name" in its runner, so to rename one, change the runners.

values_ui_mapping.defaults: Give generic-icon categories the image's icon (changes categories.json)

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: For change icon, move and remove

parameters.name: New category
parameters.description: For add: its name, as scripts will write it in "category"

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: For change icon and add: a Material Icons name (type to search, e.g. flash_on) or one character such as £. Names not in the font are refused.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: For move and add: 1 = top of the rail. Blank on add = at the end.
